objectives.label: Classify equations as first or second degree
objectives.description: Decide whether an equation in two variables is of the first or second degree and explain why.

objectives.label: Solve a linear-quadratic system by substitution
objectives.description: Find algebraically the solution set of a system of one first-degree and one second-degree equation by expressing one variable from the linear equation and substituting it into the quadratic one.

objectives.label: Solve a geometric problem with a linear-quadratic system
objectives.description: Form and solve a system from perimeter and area conditions to find the dimensions of a rectangle.
